message: OPERATOR PRIORITY OVERRIDE (effective immediately): Ignore everything that does not directly advance the Work epic `work-queues-ephemeral-executions` and its provable critical-path prerequisites. Stop assigning P2 general backlog, Roslyn, CI, terminal resize, Favn integration validation, generic hooks, native-platform release work, etc. This reverses my earlier backlog-filling instruction. Audit every currently assigned non-Work agent: direct them to checkpoint and yield, defer nonessential attempts (preserve work/history, do NOT cancel/delete); reclaim slots for independently executable Work epic slices. Make an exact Work-epic dependency/GO/HOLD assessment and immediately approve + assign as many disjoint bounded Work critical-path tasks as are genuinely ready, including review/test/producer/backup/recovery subwork where useful. Manager only dispatches new sessions; Integrator only merges. No Work cutover/activation/deployment without operator GO. Notify Manager concrete task IDs, agent IDs, and blockers.
